issue.title: write_sdd_files projects plan header sections before validating, so a malformed header raises a bare ValueError
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-g4.4 (epic sase-g4). Not caused by that epic: this is the same pre-existing defect shape sase-g4.4 fixed at the archive boundary, at a second boundary the epic's phase description did not name.

src/sase/sdd/_write.py::write_sdd_files calls project_plan_header_sections() at line 85 and only then calls validate_plan_for_commit() at line 95. project_plan_header_sections() upserts the PARENT/PROMPT/BEAD sections, and the Rust binding refuses to update a document whose existing header block is invalid, so a malformed source escapes as a bare 'validation: <reason>' ValueError with no path, no line, no code, and no remedy -- precisely the failure mode that produced epic sase-g4 in the first place.

sase-g4.4 fixed the identical ordering in src/sase/sdd/plan_archive.py::archive_plan_file (commit b08862001): validate_plan_for_commit() now runs before projection, so the caller gets the actionable header-invalid diagnostic (path, line, code, reason, remedy) and nothing is written. The comment at plan_archive.py:112-117 records why the reorder is safe -- projection only rewrites derived header sections into canonical form, so a document that fails validation before projection would fail identically after it.

Live caller: src/sase/axe/run_agent_exec_plan_accept.py:461.

Reachability note: after sase-g4, the approval gate rejects a malformed plan before this path runs for approved plans, so this is defence in depth rather than a currently-reproducing user-visible failure. It is worth closing because it is the last known instance of the shape, and any future non-approval caller of write_sdd_files reintroduces the bad error.

Scope: apply the same reorder in _write.py (validate the pre-projection content, passing the source path), and add a test asserting that a malformed header block raises the actionable diagnostic and that no SDD file was written. Mirror tests/sdd/test_plan_archive.py::test_archive_rejects_malformed_header_before_writing_destination.
